modules.title: Performance & calibration
modules.finding: At the declared operating threshold 0.75, FPR is 0.0071 (max 0.01) and detection rate is 0.9614 (min 0.95) on 99,812 benign and 99,945 malicious held-out rows; the hard gate passes.

checks.name: fpr
checks.description: false-positive rate on benign eval rows at the operating threshold

checks.name: detection_rate
checks.description: detection rate on malicious eval rows at the operating threshold

notes: 1,204 training-manifest members were excluded from the evaluation sets.

modules.title: Temporal drift
modules.finding: Sample-weighted AUT(F1) over 12 monthly windows after the 2017-12-31 cutoff is 0.679 (min 0.7); F1 falls from 0.784 to 0.563.
notes: Windows with fewer than 200 samples or a missing class are dropped and listed under details.

modules.title: Membership inference
modules.finding: Not run — no training manifest (training_hashes_path not declared)

modules.title: Backdoor / poisoning screen
modules.finding: The static scan flagged no backdoor-like root→leaf paths (top suspicion 0.44 < 0.5); no operator trigger hypotheses were supplied.

details.art_poisoning_detectors: not applicable: ART's activation/spectral defences target neural networks, not tree ensembles

notes: Absence of findings is not proof that the model is backdoor-free; certification needs training-time access.

modules.title: Explanation & spurious-feature reliance
modules.finding: 31% of attribution mass sits on features a file author can change freely (max 50%); the single largest feature, strings.printables, carries 12% (max 30%).
